tools.name: search_condos
tools.description: Search condos for rent or sale in Bangkok by budget (THB), bedrooms, BTS/MRT station or line, walking minutes to the station, district and size. Returns the matching listings with their bkkradar.com links and the same search on the map. Show the links to the user.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Details of one listing found by search_condos or nearby_condos: price, size, bedrooms, furnishing, pets, deposit, minimum lease, amenities, station and walk, and a warning when the post asks for money before a viewing. Returns its bkkradar.com link.

tools.name: list_stations
tools.description: Bangkok's BTS, MRT and Airport Link stations with the number of rentals within 1 km and the median monthly rent by bedrooms (studio, 1, 2, 3+), busiest first, optionally for one line. Each station has its bkkradar.com page.

tools.name: area_stats
tools.description: Median rent or sale price and number of listings for one BTS/MRT station (within 1 km), one line, or one district or neighbourhood of Bangkok, overall and by bedrooms. Use it to tell whether a price is fair. Returns the bkkradar.com page.

tools.name: nearby_condos
tools.description: Condos around a point in Bangkok, such as an office, a school, a residence or a station, given as lat/lng or as a place name or address. Same filters as search_condos plus radius_km, sorted by distance or by walk to a station. Returns bkkradar.com links.

tools.name: condo_stats
tools.description: One condo building's prices: median rent and sale price by bedrooms, price per m² against its district and Bangkok, gross rental yield, and the last known prices when it has few listings. Returns its bkkradar.com page.

tools.name: price_check
tools.description: Tells whether a rent or sale price is below, in line with or above the market: per m² against the same residence, station or district, same bedrooms first. Give a listing id, or a price with size or bedrooms and a place. Gives the median and the typical range.

tools.name: compare_areas
tools.description: Two to five BTS/MRT stations, lines, districts, neighbourhoods or residences side by side: listings, median price, typical range (middle half) and price per m², for rent or sale, optionally for one number of bedrooms. Returns each place's bkkradar.com page.

tools.name: price_drops
tools.description: Listings reposted at a lower price over the last 30 days, with the previous price and the drop in %, largest first. Same filters as search_condos: budget, bedrooms, station, line, district. Returns bkkradar.com links.

tools.name: rent_trend
tools.description: BKK Radar's monthly rent index for condos: median rent, rent per m², listings and change on the month before, for Bangkok, one district or one line. Started in October 2026; the current month is provisional. Returns the index page.

tools.name: request_agent_intro
tools.description: A bkkradar.com link where the user asks for viewings: Robin, who runs BKK Radar, checks their brief on WhatsApp, then introduces one local agent. Free for them. Offer it when they want to visit or want help. Pass their budget, bedrooms and area to fill in the brief.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing · Public sink: get_listing · Destructive: price_drops.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing · Public sink: get_listing · Destructive: price_drops

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
